blocks.content: The following questions are sample objective questions based on frequently asked topics in Kerala PSC and SI examinations. Study the chapters above thoroughly, then test yourself with these questions.
Mastering objective questions requires a balanced blend of speed, factual accuracy, and strategic elimination.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Objective questions test conceptual clarity, speed, and elimination techniques under strict exam time limits.
Always read the complete question stem carefully before reviewing options to avoid falling into trap choices.
Use the process of elimination to systematically eliminate improbable options and maximize accuracy.
Pay special attention to crucial qualifying keywords such as 'NOT', 'INCORRECT', 'ONLY', and 'EXCEPT'.
Negative keywords like 'NOT' or 'EXCEPT' are frequently used in competitive exams to trigger deliberate errors.
Avoid uneducated blind guessing in exams with negative marking; attempt questions only when at least two options can be reliably eliminated.
Manage your time strictly by skipping excessively lengthy questions during the first pass of the paper.

cells: A) January 26, 1950 B) November 1, 1956 C) October 15, 1960 D) August 15, 1947
Who was the first Chief Minister of Kerala?
A) C. Achutha Menon B) K. Karunakaran C) E.M.S. Namboodiripad D) Pattom A. Thanu Pillai
Which is the highest peak in Kerala?
A) Brahmagiri B) Chembra C) Agasthyamala D) Anamudi
Vasco da Gama landed at which place in Kerala?
A) Kochi B) Kollam C) Kappad, Kozhikode D) Thrissur
Which is the largest district in Kerala by area?
A) Idukki B) Palakkad C) Wayanad D) Thrissur
Thrissur Pooram is associated with which deity?
A) Krishna B) Shiva (Vadakkunnathan) C) Devi D) Vishnu
The Battle of Colachel (1741) was fought between Travancore and:
A) Portuguese B) British C) French D) Dutch
D) Dutch — First Asian victory over Europeans
A) Chattampi Swamikal B) Sree Narayana Guru C) Ayyankali D) Mannathu Padmanabhan
The first Jnanpith Award given to Kerala was to:
A) Thakazhi B) M.T. Vasudevan Nair C) G. Sankara Kurup D) S.K. Pottekkat
C) G. Sankara Kurup (1965) — also the first Jnanpith Award in India
Which is the state animal of Kerala?
A) Tiger B) Lion-tailed Macaque C) Indian Elephant D) Nilgiri Tahr
Who is known as the 'Maker of Modern Travancore'?
A) Dharmaraja B) Sree Padmanabha Dasa C) Marthanda Varma D) Swati Tirunal
The Nehru Trophy Boat Race is held at:
A) Ashtamudi Lake B) Vembanad Lake (Punnamada) C) Paravur Lake D) Kayamkulam Lake
Which is the largest lake in Kerala?
A) Ashtamudi B) Punnamada C) Vembanad D) Sasthamkotta
Koodiyattam, the UNESCO Heritage art, is which type of art?
A) Dance B) Sanskrit Theatre C) Martial Art D) Puppet Show
Which dam is known as India's first arch dam?
A) Banasura Sagar B) Malampuzha C) Idukki D) Pamba
A) The British Governor B) Zamorin C) Divan C.P. Ramaswamy Iyer D) The Portuguese
K.R. Narayanan, India's first Dalit President, was from which Kerala district?
A) Alappuzha B) Kottayam C) Thrissur D) Ernakulam
VSSC (Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre) is located at:
A) Kochi B) Palakkad C) Thiruvananthapuram D) Thrissur
Which is the state flower of Kerala?
A) Lotus B) Jasmine C) Golden Shower (Kanikonna) D) Rose
A) British colonial rule B) Untouchability and temple road restrictions C) Feudal land ownership D) Heavy taxation
B) Untouchability — protesting restriction on lower castes on roads near Vaikom Temple
A) First IT park in India B) Largest IT park in world C) First Asian IT park D) Oldest SEZ in India
A) First IT park in India (established 1990; operational 1995)
The Agasthyamala Biosphere Reserve is mainly in which district?
A) Idukki B) Wayanad C) Thiruvananthapuram (Pathanamthitta) D) Kollam
Which is the longest river flowing entirely within Kerala?
A) Periyar B) Pamba C) Kabani D) Bharathapuzha
B) Pamba (the longest river entirely within Kerala; Periyar originates in Tamil Nadu)
The Cheraman Juma Mosque, considered India's first mosque, is in:
A) Kozhikode B) Malappuram C) Kodungallur, Thrissur D) Kasaragod
The 'Kerala Model of Development' is characterized by:
A) High GDP but low human development B) High HDI despite moderate income C) Industrial-led growth D) Dependence on IT sector
B) High HDI (health, education, gender equality) despite moderate per capita income
